notes:
Background: Quiver builds an SDR outbound platform (sequence + live chat) used by ~350 mid-market customers. Product team evaluating Redwood for low-latency streaming chat + tool-calls into CRM and calendar. They prefer starting on Hosted API for fast time-to-value then shift to Dedicated for predictable throughput.

Recent calls & quotes:
- 2026-01-20 kickoff w/ Ava + Liam + Quiver product lead (Samir): demo interest, asked for streaming + function-calls into HubSpot + Google Calendar.
- 2026-01-27 technical deep-dive w/ SE Liam: discussed KV cache for session state, continuous batching, and fallback to smaller quantized model.
- 2026-02-02 pricing call: finance wants Dedicated price bands if ARR > $75k/yr.
- Quote from Samir: "Streaming needs to feel instantaneous for reps — p95 under 150ms or users complain."

POC details (hosted -> Dedicated evaluation):
- POC objective: measure p50/p95 end-to-end for streaming chat with tool-calls (CRM update, send email, create calendar event).
- SLO target: p95 <= 150ms for short-turn responses (tool-confirmation path), acceptable tail to 300ms for long generations.
- Test dataset: 10k simulated outbound interactions, mix of short confirmations (3-12 tokens) and longer snippets (50-200 tokens).
- Instrumentation requested: token-level latency breakdown, per-route dashboards, error traces when tool-calls fail.
- Cost sensitivity: product ops wants cost per conversation <= $0.08 on avg; finance tolerates higher during POC.

Integration & security notes:
- Must support HubSpot tool-calls (write contacts, timeline events) and Gmail/Calendar integrations via function/tool calling.
- Data residency: EU customers require EU data at rest; asking whether Hosted can guarantee EU residency or if Private/Dedicated needed.
- Compliance: SOC2 + audit logging required before procurement. SSO SAML required for admin console.

Operational concerns raised:
- Multi-tenant isolation for customer data (Quiver stores per-customer prompt history).
- Cache invalidation semantics for KV cache across rolling updates.
- Fallback model behavior: need configurable routing to cheaper model under load with preserved UX.

Next steps (agreed):
- Redwood to spin up 2-week hosted POC starting 2026-02-05 (Ava to share test tokens + sample traffic).
- SE to deliver POC config: streaming enabled, function-calls mapped to HubSpot + Calendar endpoints, metrics hooks.
- Finance + Quiver to review Dedicated pricing on 2026-02-25 demo.
- Legal to receive DPA + data residency statement (Ava sent drive link).

Open questions / blockers:
- Can Hosted guarantee EU residency for token storage? If not, Dedicated or Private likely required.
- Clarify default streaming latency under concurrent load (expected 200 concurrent reps).
- Price breakpoints for Dedicated (committed throughput) vs pay-as-you-go hosted.

CRM stubs & refs:
- Drive: drive://quiver/prod-pricing-deck-v3 (shared 2026-01-22)
- Fireflies: ff_2026-01-20-QUV-01 (kickoff), ff_2026-02-02-QUV-02 (pricing)
- Jira: RDW-1198 (POC env setup), RDW-1244 (EU residency question)

Sales notes (shorthand):
- Champion = Samir (product lead) — cares about latency and UX.
- Economic buyer = CFO — needs Dedicated price certainty.
- Timing = Q2 close target if POC ok.
- Risk = security/residency + pricing delta for Dedicated.
